name: GitLab K3s Managed Deploy
description: Reusable workflow for remote app/site/game deployment through GitLab repository trees, managed-app evidence, remote-cli-agent implementation, and k3s public verification.

chain.step: Patch GitLab tree with remote CLI worker when implementation is needed
Observe pipeline, image, and managed-app build state
Deploy or roll forward the known image
Verify rollout and public HTTPS/browser behavior
